title: Log abundance in numerical dimension one for threefolds in positive characteristic
main_claim: For p>3, a projective lc threefold pair (X,B) with rational boundary and K_X+B nef of numerical dimension one has K_X+B semiample. The nef-dimension ≤2 cases follow from Xu. The proof assumes n=3 and then builds from (X,B) the prepared cycle (V,D,H_V) that the companion paper rules out.

issues.location: Sec. 3 (Prop. boundary separation), Sec. 4 (Prop. isolation), Sec. 5 (Prop. boundary torsion)
issues.description: Several key steps are black-boxed to recent preprints that could not be checked independently: the partial-MMP conclusion and the S2-ification/adjunction form (Xu 2026, Prop. 2.21/Lemma 2.24/Lemma 2.19), termination (Xu, Thm 1.5), JLR quantitative bend-and-break, and Posva's slc surface abundance. The way these are applied matches their stated hypotheses (dlt lowered pair, pseudoeffective via the effective representative τN−εS, curve in the smooth locus, nef Cartier test divisor). The JLR constant 4 does not matter, because the ratio NC_l/(−K_X C_l) tends to 0.
issues.evidence: Checked: NC_l/(−K C_l) = NH^2/(−KH^2 − l·KHN) → 0, using KNH<0, which comes from BNH>0 and (K+B)NH=0.

coverage:
Read the whole paper (foundations, boundary, isolation, torsion, cycle). Checked the steps below.
- Reduction: relative terminal MMP over the dlt model; the negativity lemma gives F≤0, so B_t is effective; ν=1 and n=3 are preserved.
- Boundary separation: complete-intersection curves, the bend-and-break ratio, and the very-general-point incidence argument; the disjointness comes from Lemma 2.2.
- Isolation: an lc place over Supp N lies in ⌊G⌋ and in a component S⊂Supp N; the extracted divisors respect the separation; the MMP rays are N-trivial and S-positive, so S survives; the pullback equality comes from negativity applied to ±F; U_X is preserved (contracted curves lie in Supp N); there is no Mori fibre space because the class is effective; the anti-nef restriction makes S_Y disjoint from the other components; Y is klt.
- dlt corollary.
- Torsion lemma: depth/local duality finiteness of H^2_m, injectivity of the connecting map giving the zero map on H^1_Z, the p-power gluing, and the no-zeros argument.
- Prepared cycle: the divisor of the log-canonical section θ; exceptional centres are separated because terminal implies finite Sing X; the tame root cover and the Jacobian section ψ of ω^{p^b}; C is a connected component of Supp ρ^*N_0; nefness, D^2H=0 and torsion pullback; Hodge-index proportionality on surfaces T∈|lH_V| containing a given curve; transfer of n=3.
- Companion: confirmed that the companion's Sections 3–6 retain only V, D, H, the torsion order and the local canonical relation (its preparation.tex line ~893 and slopes.tex intro), so it is legitimate to use the obstruction as a black box.
sibling_notes: The companion (terminal case, rank 182) was reported no_gap_found by a sibling. This paper depends essentially on that companion's obstruction, and I confirmed that the obstruction's later sections use only the prepared data (V, D, H, torsion, local canonical relation of the form ω^{p^b}≅O(Σ b_α D_α)), which this paper constructs.
